limitations: Equal-radius perpendicular concurrent infinite solid cylinders, isotropic direction. Numerical checks are diagnostics; independent audit absent and historic literature search not exhaustive.
scientific_integrity: Complete three-cylinder support function, one-integral isotropic CDF, exact high-width linear interval and sharp logarithmic low-width asymptotic are proved. Finch arXiv:1110.0671v1 has a precisely verified first public date of 2011-10-04; older cylinder-intersection articles are also cited, but their accessible bibliographic entries lack exact first-public days. No historical-priority claim follows from that date.
title: An exact directional-width quadrature and two contrasting tails for the Steinmetz tricylinder
